column1: # comment: "Name alignments for comprehensive, multi-culture interop \u2014 schema.org, vCard 4 (N components, nickname, fn), GEDCOM X (gx:) name parts, FOAF, and a few well-established Wikidata properties. Multi-cultural name-part KINDS (gmeow:NamePartType value individuals such as namePartGiven/namePartSurname) align closeMatch to the nearest external concept, following the places.ttl idiom; there are no flat given/family name properties \u2014 a 'First Last' rendering is produced by downcasting the structured gmeow:NamePart model in the projection layer (projections/*). The PronounSet CLASS and the hasPronounSet PROPERTY now align (closeMatch) to Wikidata's 'personal pronoun set' (Q65067284) and 'personal pronoun' (P6553) \u2014 verified live against the Wikidata API \u2014 whose Sept-2025 RfC calls for full-declension pronoun sets (each set's forms, not a single lexeme) \u2014 aligning with GMEOW's reified five-form English model; the per-set declensions, NameRegister, NameUsage and the inclusivity machinery (displayable, namePurposeChosen/Deadname) remain CANONICAL \u2014 no maintained external RDF vocabulary declines individual sets faithfully (the pronoun ANCHOR list is sourced from the pronouns.page structured database, cited in names.ttl + docs/identity-mapping.md). Co-equality of multilingual names is a structural stance, not an external mapping. Coreference of name INSTANCES is done in data, not here."

RETENTION (negative supersession — NOT a Section-Retraction): gmeow:NameUsage is RETAINED. It is the reified observation-spine logic:Relator binding {named entity}×{appellation}×{audience}×{register}×{period}×{evidence} — WHO calls WHOM by which name, toward what audience, in what register, over what interval, on what evidence. lang:Denotation is the reference corner of the Frege triangle (form→referent meaning), carrying none of the audience / register / period / authority / evidence axes. A NameUsage may CARRY a denotation (its appellation's form denotes the named entity through gmeow:appellationDenotation), but the relator's perspectival, standpoint-scoped binding is not recoverable from a meaning record, so lang:Denotation cannot retract onto NameUsage. relatedMatch: related through the shared naming act, on disjoint axes.
CIDOC-CRM E48 Place Name — the appellation borne by a place (CRM's E53 Place)
Wikidata 'pronoun' — broader grammatical category; a hint, not an equivalence

Wikidata 'personal pronoun set' — third-person pronouns an individual wants used; its Sept-2025 RfC favours full-declension pronoun sets (modelling each set's forms, not a single lexeme), aligning with GMEOW's reified five-form English model
schema:name — broad: a SoftwareName is a kind of name borne by a software project

GRAFT SEAM (new consumer, not a supersession): gmeow:appellationDenotation is the naming→referent bridge grounded in lang: (Principle 19). It relates a gmeow:Appellation to the reified lang:Denotation in which the appellation's lang:Form denotes its bearer — lang:denotationKind lang:denotesEntity, lang:denotationTarget the named gmeow:Entity, lang:denotedForm the appellation's non-surface form. The names slice thereby REUSES the lang: reference corner rather than minting a local meaning record; co-reference is a shared lang:denotationTarget. relatedMatch: the property points AT a lang:Denotation, it is not equivalent to one.
GMEOW fullName close-matches OntoLex writtenRep
schema:name — downcast: an agreement's structured name objects flatten to the schema:name literal in projection

RETENTION (negative supersession — NOT a Section-Retraction): the core naming-relation family — gmeow:hasAppellation (representative) and its specializations gmeow:hasName / gmeow:hasPlaceName / gmeow:hasOrganizationName / gmeow:hasAgreementName, plus the NameUsage players gmeow:usageNamed / gmeow:usageAppellation — is RETAINED. These are BEARING relations (an entity BEARS a co-equal name-object) or relator-player bindings, structurally distinct from the form→referent MEANING that a lang:Denotation records. A name's form denotes its bearer (the new gmeow:appellationDenotation seam), but the entity→name-object bearing is a separate fact that lang:Denotation carries no term for. lang:Denotation cannot retract onto the bearing family; the denotation is layered ON TOP of the retained bearing. relatedMatch: bearing and denoting meet at the appellation but are disjoint relations.

RETENTION (negative supersession — NOT a Section-Retraction): gmeow:nameLanguage is RETAINED. Its range gmeow:Language survives the graft (a language is grafted as a lang:SignSystem but kept as a gmeow: term); nameLanguage carries the FUNCTIONAL language-of-the-form facet (exactly one gmeow:Language per appellation), an axis of the FORM corner, not the reference corner. lang:Denotation is form→referent meaning and has no term for which language a name's surface is in, so it cannot supersede nameLanguage. relatedMatch: both sit on the Frege triangle but on different corners (form-language vs reference).
Wikidata 'endonym' (Q1266782) — verified live against the Wikidata API
Wikidata 'exonym' (Q81639) — verified live against the Wikidata API

REGROUNDING (retention + carrier migration): gmeow:nameScript is RETAINED but migrated from an owl:DatatypeProperty carrying a bare ISO 15924 literal to an owl:ObjectProperty whose rdfs:range is lang:Script. The ISO 15924 code ("Hani", "Latn", "Jpan") now rides the lang:Script individual's skos:notation, so script identity is shared with the writing-system / notation graft rather than duplicated as an opaque per-name tag, and a code-less or newly-minted script names co-equally. The name→script facet survives verbatim; only its carrier deepened. relatedMatch: the property now points at the lang:Script individual it formerly encoded as a string.

RETENTION (negative supersession — NOT a Section-Retraction): gmeow:romanization is RETAINED. It is a Latin-script transliteration of THE SAME appellation (a form→form rendering-layer datum, whose producing system is named by the language slice's gmeow:transliterationScheme, already regrounded onto lang:TransliterationMap in the Task-2 graft). It is NOT a meaning record: it never bridges two co-equal names and never targets a referent. lang:Denotation is form→referent meaning and cannot carry a transliteration string, so it does not supersede romanization; the transliteration axis belongs to lang:Rendering / lang:TransliterationMap, not lang:Denotation. relatedMatch: both concern a form, on the rendering vs reference axes.
